summary: Iteration 97 (backend + frontend): Ri.Ba. avviso insoluto to the client. BACKEND 12/12 pass, using a local SMTP sink that writes every received message to disk, so the email content was checked. (1) POST /riba/insoluti avvisa=true with no SMTP configured: the insoluto is still registered, avvisi=0, and errori contains 'Insoluto registrato, avviso non inviato: Configura il server email (SMTP)...'. No avviso field is written. (2) With SMTP configured (127.0.0.1:1025, security none), a block of 3 effetti gives registrati=3 and avvisi=2: client A has an email, client B has only a PEC (the PEC is used), and client C has neither, so errori says 'Insoluto registrato, avviso non inviato: Il cliente ... non ha un indirizzo email o PEC valido'. (3) The effetto avviso field holds {to, email_id, totale 129 = 122 + 7 spese, inviato_il, inviato_da}. (4) The email subject is 'Avviso di insoluto - fattura N/2026 - <Azienda>'. The html contains the fattura number, original scadenza, data insoluto, importo 122,00 €, 'Spese di insoluto addebitate 7,00 €' (only when spese_cliente>0; absent for client B), Totale 129,00 €, the nuova scadenza and the company IBAN. (5) avvisa defaults to false: no email and no avviso field. (6) GET /riba/insoluti-registrati returns exactly the insoluto effetti, without _id. (7) POST /riba/effetti/{eid}/avviso resend gives a new email_id and inviato_il and sends exactly one mail. Sending after an earlier SMTP failure works. A client with no email gives 400, a presentato effetto gives 400, an unknown id gives 404, and no auth gives 401. FRONTEND (Riba > Esitazione effetti, 1920px): blocco-avvisa is checked by default. Registering A + C gives the toasts '2 insoluti registrati · nuova scadenza 16/12/2026 · 1 avvisi email inviati' and '3/2026: Insoluto registrato, avviso non inviato: ...'. The insoluti-registrati section appears with ins-row-{id}. Row A shows ins-avviso 'Inviato il 16/11/2026' with the button 'Reinvia'. Row C has no status and shows 'Invia avviso'. With avvisa unchecked, the toast has no avvisi part. 'Invia avviso' on B gives the toast 'Avviso inviato a <pec>', and the row switches to Inviato/Reinvia. 'Invia avviso' on C gives an error toast. Reinvia on A gives a success toast. 'Importo + spese' shows '122,00 € + 7,00 €'.

minor.issue: There is no rate limit or duplicate guard. Reinvia can be clicked repeatedly and sends one email each time. The sollecito endpoint caps this at 3 per 24h.
SMTP config is not checked up front. When SMTP is missing, every effetto in the block produces its own 'avviso non inviato' error, so N error toasts appear in the UI.

issues: Grammar: the toast says '1 avvisi email inviati'. It should be singular ('1 avviso email inviato').
Rows without an avviso show no status (ins-avviso-{id} is not rendered). A failed send (e.g. no email) is not persisted or shown, so a muted 'Non inviato' or 'Email mancante' badge would help.
The 'Inviato il' status does not show the recipient. Consider a title or tooltip with avviso.to.
Reinvia sends straight away with no confirm.
From before this change: the date fields (blocco-dal/al/data) use the browser's native date picker, not the shadcn calendar.

action_items: Optional: add a resend throttle on /riba/effetti/{eid}/avviso, like the 3/24h limit on solleciti.
Optional: when avvisa=true, check SMTP once before the loop and return a single error.
Optional UI: show singular/plural correctly in the toast, show a 'Non inviato' status, show a recipient tooltip, and ask for confirmation before Reinvia.
critical_code_review_comments: _avviso_insoluto uses e['scadenza'] as the 'scadenza originale'. That is correct for the effetto, but after a second insoluto on the same rata the effetto's scadenza is the re-presented date. This is fine as long as each effetto is its own record.
Avviso failures are not stored on the effetto, so the UI cannot tell 'never attempted' apart from 'failed'.
riba.py (542 lines) and RibaInsolutiBlocco.jsx (131 lines) are fine. server.py is 4787 lines; consider moving the email/avviso helpers into comunicazioni.py.
seed_data_creation: A temporary TEST_T97 Riba <RUN> Srl company, a user and a session were created and then removed by company_id and user_id (verified: 0 left). The SMTP sink process was killed and /tmp/t97_mail removed. No seeded or user data was touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Start the sink first: cd /app/backend && nohup python3 tests/t97_smtp_sink.py & (saves .eml files in /tmp/t97_mail; python 3.11 still has smtpd, aiosmtpd is not installed). Full suite: pytest tests/test_iteration97_riba_avviso_insoluto.py -n 0 -p no:cacheprovider. For UI data use T97_KEEP=1 ... -k test_02: this creates the company, SMTP, clients A(email)/B(pec)/C(none) and 5 maturato effetti plus 1 presentato. Then set the session_token cookie and localStorage fe_company_id, and open /riba tab riba-tab-insoluti. Clean up manually by company_id afterwards.
